info.name: Kinde Account API Keys Self-serve portal API

params.name: subnav
params.description: The area of the portal you want the user to land on

params.name: return_url
params.description: The URL to redirect the user to after they have completed their actions in the portal.

items.docs: Returns a link to the self-serve portal for the authenticated user. The user can use this link to manage their account, update their profile, and view their entitlements.
